FAIL_TO_PASS: loads a CommonJS config file with cjs extension
relative-camelized: handles plugins where the export name is the camelized file name
no-dash: uses stdin input when piping into Rollup without an input
with-dash: stdin input with dash on CLI
commonjs: uses stdin to inline a require()
self-import: stdin input of code that imports a copy of itself
json: pipe JSON over stdin to create a module
loads an ESM config file with mjs extension
loads a CommonJS config file exporting a config as a function with defineConfig()
config-file: does not replace input with stdin but allows referencing it when using a config file
